create_TaskHook_subclass: create a custom TaskHook subclass that overrides task_hook to add logging for each pipeline task
build_TaskStatsHook_with_interval: build a TaskStatsHook instance with periodic interval reporting to track pipeline task performance stats
use_stage_hooks_compose: use _stage_hooks to compose multiple TaskHook stage context managers into a single async context manager
use_task_hooks_compose: use _task_hooks to compose multiple TaskHook task context managers into a single async context manager for each task
set_default_hook_class: set the default hook class for all pipeline stages by calling set_default_hook_class with a custom TaskHook subclass
